description: This file defines macros and prototypes for managing commit slabs, which are data structures used to allocate and handle memory chunks for commit objects in a version control system or similar project. It includes definitions for slab size, macros for declaring and initializing slabs, and function prototypes for slab operations.

methods.name: init_<slabname>_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a commit slab with a specific stride value.

methods.name: init_<slabname>
methods.description: Initializes a commit slab with default parameters.

methods.name: clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Clears a commit slab, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: deep_clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Deeply clears a commit slab, freeing all contained elements using a custom free function.

methods.name: <slabname>_at_peek
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a certain position in the slab, with optional addition if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a certain position in the slab.

methods.name: <slabname>_peek
methods.description: Peeks at an element in the slab at a specific position.
